## Practice RTMB

- Start with 1 stock and see if you can forecast
- Include age as part of the model
- One option is to have a different Ricker curve for each age class
- Add covariates
- Run a retrospective analysis over the last 12 years of data

## Load in Data

- Example Stellako

```{r}
#| echo: true

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(RTMB)

sox <- read.csv("../data/sockeye/SRDATA2026 1.csv")
stock <- read.csv("../data/sockeye/FC_StockInfo 2.csv")
covariates <- read.csv("../data/sockeye/FC_Environmental_Data_2026_Std_Offset_Real.csv")
sox <- sox %>% left_join(stock, by = "PopID")
sox <- sox %>% left_join(covariates, by = "yr")
sox <- sox %>% filter(!is.na(spawners), !is.na(recruits))
sox <- sox %>% group_by(PopName) %>% mutate(sd_spawners = sd(spawners),  spawners_scaled = spawners/sd_spawners) %>% ungroup()

sox_ch_pred <- sox %>% filter(PopName == "Stellako") %>% filter(is.na(age5))
sox_ch <- sox %>% filter(PopName == "Stellako") %>% filter(!is.na(age5))
logRS <- cbind(log((sox_ch$age4+0.0000001)/sox_ch$spawners), log((sox_ch$age5+0.0000001)/sox_ch$spawners))
nobs <- nrow(logRS)
```

## Age Based Ricker Model

- I think that carrying capacity is shared between age classes but productivity is not.
- The observations are related so will choose,

$$
  \log(R_{at}/S_t) = N(\boldsymbol{\alpha}_a - \beta S_t, \Sigma)
$$
## Fitting it in RTMB

```{r}
params <- list(
  logsigma = 0,
  alpha = c(0,0),
  logbeta = 0,
  logitphi = 0
  )

negll <- function(pars){
  getAll(pars, sox_ch, warn = FALSE)

  phi <- -1 + 2*plogis(logitphi)
  sigma <- exp(logsigma)
  beta <- exp(logbeta)
  Sigma <- sigma*diag(2)
  Sigma[1,2] <- phi*(sigma^2) 
  Sigma[2,1] <- phi*(sigma^2)
  ll <- 0
  for(i in 1:nobs) 
    ll <- ll + dmvnorm(logRS[i,], alpha - beta*spawners[i], Sigma = Sigma, log = TRUE)
  REPORT(Sigma)
  return(-ll)
}

obj <- MakeADFun(negll, params, silent = TRUE)
fit <- nlminb(obj$par, obj$fn, obj$gr)

## Prediction:
## Predict age 5 given age 4:
pred_new <- function(mu_current, mu_next, Scurrent = 1, Snext = 1, N_age4, Sigma){
  ## Age 5 prediction
  mean_age5 <- mu[2] - (N_age4 - mu_current[1])*Sigma[1,2]/Sigma[1,1]
  mu_next[1]*Snext + mean_age5*Scurrent
}

pList <- obj$env$parList(fit$par)
Sigma <- obj$report()$Sigma
Snext <- sox_ch_pred$spawners
Scurrent <- sox_ch %>% slice(n()) %>% select(spawners) %>% unlist()
mucurrent <- pList$alpha - exp(pList$logbeta)*Scurrent
munext <- pList$alpha - exp(pList$logbeta)*Snext
age4 <- sox_ch_pred$age4
newyear <- pred_new(mu_current = mucurrent, mu_next = munext, Scurrent = Scurrent, Snext  = Snext, N_age4 = sox_ch_pred$age4, Sigma = Sigma)
```

## Adding Covariates

```{r}

params <- list(
  logsigma = 0,
  alpha = c(0,0),
  a = numeric(4),
  logbeta = 0,
  logitphi = 0
  )

negll <- function(pars){
  getAll(pars, sox_ch, warn = FALSE)

  phi <- -1 + 2*plogis(logitphi)
  sigma <- exp(logsigma)
  beta <- exp(logbeta)
  Sigma <- sigma*diag(2)
  Sigma[1,2] <- phi*(sigma^2) 
  Sigma[2,1] <- phi*(sigma^2)
  
  delta_alpha <- a[1]*pdo + a[2]*stn2js + a[3]*peak + a[4]*mapsst
  
  ll <- 0
  for(i in 1:nobs) 
    ll <- ll + dmvnorm(logRS[i,], alpha + delta_alpha[i] - beta*spawners[i], Sigma = Sigma, log = TRUE)
  REPORT(Sigma)
  return(-ll)
}

obj <- MakeADFun(negll, params, silent = TRUE)
fit <- nlminb(obj$par, obj$fn, obj$gr)

pList <- obj$env$parList(fit$par)
Sigma <- obj$report()$Sigma
a <- pList$a
sox_current <- sox_ch %>% slice(n())
alphanext <- pList$alpha + a[1]*sox_ch_pred$pdo + a[2]*sox_ch_pred$stn2js + a[3]*sox_ch_pred$peak + a[4]*sox_ch_pred$mapsst
alphacurrent <- pList$alpha + a[1]*sox_current$pdo + a[2]*sox_current$stn2js + a[3]*sox_current$peak + a[4]*sox_current$mapsst

Snext <- sox_ch_pred$spawners
Scurrent <- sox_ch %>% slice(n()) %>% select(spawners) %>% unlist()
mucurrent <- alphacurrent - exp(pList$logbeta)*Scurrent
munext <- alphanext - exp(pList$logbeta)*Snext
age4 <- sox_ch_pred$age4
newyear <- pred_new(mu_current = mucurrent, mu_next = munext, Scurrent = Scurrent, Snext  = Snext, N_age4 = sox_ch_pred$age4, Sigma = Sigma)
```

## Forecast

```{r}
years <- 2000:2021
pred <- NULL
for( i in seq_along(years) ){
  sox_ch <- sox %>% filter(PopName == "Stellako", yr < years[i])
  sox_pred <- sox %>% filter(PopName == "Stellako", yr == years[i])
  logRS <- cbind(log((sox_ch$age4+0.0000001)/sox_ch$spawners),
                 log((sox_ch$age5+0.0000001)/sox_ch$spawners))
  nobs <- nrow(logRS)

  obj <- MakeADFun(negll, params, silent = TRUE)
  fit <- nlminb(obj$par, obj$fn, obj$gr)

  pList <- obj$env$parList(fit$par)
  Sigma <- obj$report()$Sigma
  a <- pList$a
  sox_current <- sox_ch %>% slice(n())
  alphanext <- pList$alpha + a[1]*sox_pred$pdo + a[2]*sox_pred$stn2js + a[3]*sox_pred$peak + a[4]*sox_pred$mapsst
  alphacurrent <- pList$alpha + a[1]*sox_current$pdo + a[2]*sox_current$stn2js + a[3]*sox_current$peak + a[4]*sox_current$mapsst
  
  Snext <- sox_ch_pred$spawners
  Scurrent <- sox_ch %>% slice(n()) %>% select(spawners) %>% unlist()
  mucurrent <- alphacurrent - exp(pList$logbeta)*Scurrent
  munext <- alphanext - exp(pList$logbeta)*Snext
  age4 <- sox_ch_pred$age4
  newyear <- pred_new(mu_current = mucurrent, mu_next = munext, Scurrent = Scurrent, Snext  = Snext, N_age4 = sox_ch_pred$age4, Sigma = Sigma)

  pred <- c(pred, newyear)
}
pred <- cbind(year = years + 4, pred)

library(tidyr)
recruits_ch <- sox %>% filter(PopName == "Stellako", yr < years[i]) %>% 
  pivot_longer(c(age4, age5)) %>% mutate(year = ifelse(name == "age4", yr + 4, yr + 5))
recruits_ch <- recruits_ch %>% group_by(year) %>% summarize(recruits = sum(value))

recruits_ch %>% ggplot(aes(x = year, y = recruits)) + geom_line() + theme_minimal() +
  geom_line(data = pred, aes(x = year, y = pred), col = 'red')
```
